# EcoMate

> EcoMate is the complete operating platform for scaling e-commerce businesses in Bangladesh. It unifies online stores, physical showrooms, multi-warehouse inventory, smart barcode packing, courier reconciliation, double-entry finance and marketing in one control centre.

EcoMate sells to high-volume Bangladeshi e-commerce brands and merchants who have outgrown
spreadsheets and disconnected tools. It is deployed as a Next.js application on Cloudflare
Workers and is available in English and Bangla.

## What it does

- **Order management** — every channel's order in one queue, with selective routing per SKU.
- **Multi-warehouse inventory** — bin-level stock across warehouses, with a double-entry
  ledger so every movement is balanced.
- **Smart packing** — a five-stage physical pipeline with barcode verification, which is where
  most preventable shipping errors are caught.
- **Courier reconciliation** — cash-on-delivery and return-fraud detection, cohort analysis by
  courier, and settlement reconciliation.
- **Showroom POS** — a point-of-sale surface that shares the same stock ledger as the online
  stores.
- **Marketing attribution** — server-side, deduplicated conversion tracking.
- **Team governance** — role-based access control across every surface.

## Pricing

Published tiered pricing is rendered on the marketing page and managed by the site operator.
Prices are quoted in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT). Contact the team for a custom architecture quote.

## Content

- Blog (operations and fulfilment articles): `/en/blog/<slug>`, `/bn/blog/<slug>`
- Case studies: `/en/case-studies/<slug>`, `/bn/case-studies/<slug>`

Every public URL carries `hreflang` alternates for `en`, `bn` and `x-default`, plus a
per-locale canonical. The unprefixed `/` is the canonical English URL.

## Sitemap

The machine-readable index of every indexable URL, in both locales, with `lastmod`:

https://ecomate.bd/sitemap.xml

Robots policy and crawl directives: https://ecomate.bd/robots.txt

## Notes for automated readers

- Content is rendered server-side. Text is present in the initial HTML; no client-side
  rendering is required to read a page.
- The admin area at `/admin` requires authentication and is not part of the public site.
- Structured data (Organization, Article, BreadcrumbList) is emitted inline as JSON-LD.
